fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami policing and alleged civil-rights violations (referencing the Huttoe case and a damage suit), criticism of a proposed world’s fair on the city Graves tract, and discussion of municipal governance and development. Coverage also addresses polio precautions related to school reopening and travel, opposition to a Florida sales tax and state revenue debates (including a Governor’s committee hearing), traffic enforcement and public courtesy, aircraft noise over residential areas, municipal water-rate complaints, and assorted local court and civic items, alongside advertisements and subscription/tax-coupon forms.
